t: Section 3 of the Act of December 2, 1969 (83 Stat. 279), is amended by changing “180,000” to “680,000”.

fable.w: This section only amends a prior Act by changing a numerical figure from 180,000 to 680,000. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, right to sue, or any party outside the federal government taking part in a federal decision.
